# stb_image

Header-only image decoder. Supports JPG, PNG, TGA, BMP, PSD, GIF, HDR, PIC.

**stb_image** is part of the `stb` suite and is maintained by
_Sean Barrett (nothings)_ & contributors. The full source code can be
found at [the stb repository](https://github.com/nothings/stb).
